A thought:
- We have established that the symbols on pages 51-57 decrypt to:
1033
3301
- Obviously '1033' becomes '3301' when read right-to-left.
- The clue says 'numbers are the direction'. Maybe this refers to the direction they must be read.
--> Maybe a key to decrypt the text is, if we read the first line of runes left-to-right and then the second right-to-left (and vice versa) ? (reading direction)
Hawat
